case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Prevention or enforceable refusal of unverified AI-produced assessment being claimed as the student's own.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Under Protocol v1.1, an enforceable prohibition can protect a critical risk: N087 (6.3.1) prohibits submitting work produced in part or whole using AI without specific authorisation, and N164 Schedule 1 (1.3.1-1.3.2) empowers decision-makers to disallow/amend marks or require resubmission, although operational detection is limited by disabled Turnitin AI reports (N112).
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch's Student Academic Integrity Policy (N087, 6.3.1) prohibits submitting work produced in whole or part by AI unless specifically authorised in assessment requirements, and Student Integrity Regulations (N164) empower decision-makers to disallow marks or require resubmission. While this enforceable prohibition and sanction framework addresses the critical risk, operational verification is weakened because Turnitin AI detection is disabled (N112) and the Assessment Procedure is absent from the bundle. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
